dedupe_keys.name: sedimark data pipeline and context broker toolbox

description: SEDIMARK Toolbox supplies Docker Compose deployments for data pipelines, machine-learning workflows and an NGSI-LD context broker. The project consortium documents an AI workflow stack using MageAI, MLflow, PostgreSQL and MinIO, with a separate Stellio, TimescaleDB and Kafka configuration for context information. REST APIs and a web interface support workflow management. Source access is free under MIT for this deployment repository; included services retain their own licences and operating costs. The toolbox has no fixed geographic coverage, observation period or data resolution because users supply their datasets. Its README recommends Docker 20.10 or later, Compose 2.0 or later and at least eight gigabytes of memory. No service was deployed, and the article’s decentralised exchange claims were not operationally tested. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing and managing infrastructure sensor inputs for digital-twin simulations. platform-qgis offers complementary spatial data preparation, but a direct connector was not verified.
